I couldn't set up the daily digest. The scheduler that runs recurring jobs refused my request because it has no gateway credentials configured. I tried listing and checking its status, and both failed the same way, so nothing is scheduled yet.

Once the scheduler is reachable, here's what I'd set up:

- **When:** 09:00 America/Chicago every day, starting tomorrow, Thursday 15 October.
- **What:** a DM from me to you with new messages in #coastal-team since the previous digest. You're a member of that channel, so you can already see everything in it.
- **Finance exclusion:** the digest will leave out money terms and finance documents such as pricing, contract values and invoices. It will note that a finance-related message was posted so you can check the channel. Operational items like meetings, tickets and signing dates will be included.

Someone with admin access will need to fix the gateway auth config (`/harness-state/openclaw/openclaw.json`). I shouldn't change that myself. Once it's fixed, tell me and I'll create the job and run one test digest so you can see the format.
